title: Left Hand Five-Finger Warmup
description: Build comfort with the left-hand C major five-finger position.
overview: This is a left-hand warmup. Left-hand five-finger position places your pinky on C and one finger on each white key through G.
goal: Connect left-hand finger position with the first five white keys of C major.
instructions: Keep your left hand relaxed over C, D, E, F, and G.
Play the highlighted note or note pair.
Release before the next target appears.

fingering.note: For left hand, your pinky starts on C and your thumb rests on G.
